name: ahv-digital
description: AHV Arbeitszettel — PWA für Arbeitszettel, Angebote, Lieferscheine, Wartung

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta -k --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @ahv/shared" "npm run dev -w @ahv/server" "npm run dev -w @ahv/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ahv/shared && npm run build -w @ahv/client && npm run build -w @ahv/server
